interpretation_limits: Fixed stored predictions only; percentile intervals do not remove adaptive model-selection bias.
Vessel IID may understate spatial/shared-environment dependence; spatial blocks are a sensitivity analysis, not proof of independence.
Only two OUTER months, aggregated in each vessel prediction; month-block uncertainty is not estimable here.

notes: Same ID means matching 2026 record key within this internal validation, not externally verified physical-vessel identity.
accepted_reid in trial10 means retrieval_weight>0, not a hard identification acceptance decision.
Different identity but same gear can yield correct fishing-class prediction; classification F1 is not identity accuracy.

6.interpretation: Post-hoc same-ID reference dependence diagnostic only. Removes own-ID entries from stored ranked candidates, not from TabICL contexts, ranker training, or the full pipeline. ID is used for diagnostic exclusion, not deployed prediction.
